_why: Register a recorded human voice for a Listening item here. Empty: no recording has been made (H-12). Each entry: { file, captions, scriptSha256, speaker, recordedOn, licence }. file is an audio file under access-practice-lab/, captions a WebVTT file beside it, scriptSha256 the hash printed for that item in data/language-page-audio-manifest.json (sha256 of the script, NFC, trimmed). Editing a script after it is recorded fails tools/language-page-audio.test.mjs until the item is re-recorded. Then run node tools/generate-language-page-audio-manifest.mjs.
